svg.title: VM size, disk type and power states
svg.desc: The VM vm-azb-win01 starts this lab deallocated, so you start it first. Numbered steps: 1 stop it in the portal so it is Stopped (deallocated), 2 change the size from Standard_B2s_v2 to Standard_B2ls_v2, 3 change the OS disk type, 4 start it again. A shutdown from inside Windows leaves the VM Stopped, and compute is still billed. The OS disk and the static public IP pip-azb-win01 are billed in every state.
svg.text: Billed in every state, also while the VM is deallocated
